name: Adoni Bezek
overview: The account of Adoni Bezek in Judges 1 reveals a sobering example of divine justice in the conquest of Canaan. As king of Bezek, Adoni Bezek was defeated by the tribe of Judah, who slew many of his men and captured him. His punishment—having his thumbs and great toes cut off—mirrors the cruelty he inflicted on seventy kings, demonstrating that God repays individuals according to their deeds. Ultimately, Adoni Bezek's fate underscores the sovereignty of God in executing justice and the consequences of opposition to His people.
